news_risk: No adverse regulatory action, penalty, product recall or negative news found for Haldiram Snacks Private Limited in the sources reachable during this check. Note on methodology: the DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable (connection refused) for the whole session; only Bing/Google HTML fetches and direct site fetches worked, and Bing returned almost exclusively the company's own marketing domains (haldiram.com, haldirams.com, international.haldiram.com, haldirams-usa.com) plus Wikipedia. Google returned HTTP 429. Absence of findings here therefore reflects limited source coverage, NOT a verified clean record. One item found on Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haldiram%27s, section 'Legal issues'): in 2006 co-owner Prabhu Shankar Agarwal was reported convicted in an attempted-murder case involving a Kolkata tea seller. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: that report attaches to the Nagpur-based Haldiram's group entity (Haldiram's India Pvt Ltd / Haldiram Foods International), not confirmed to be the Delhi-based Haldiram Snacks Private Limited in this batch; the two families' businesses were only demerged/merged into 'Haldiram Snacks Food' in 2022 per the same page. Treat as unverified for this specific legal entity. Per project rule 2, criminal matters are not rejection grounds and are recorded neutrally: 'есть сложности'.
note: Sanctions: no OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List listing found. The OFAC Sanctions List Search page was fetched but is JavaScript-driven and returned no query results, so this is a negative-by-absence finding, not a confirmed screen against the SDN file; UN/EU/UK/BIS lists could not be queried at all (search backend down). Court cases: no case records retrieved — Indian court databases (eCourts, NCLT, SCI) were not reachable/queried within the tool budget; court_cases = null means 'not public/not retrieved', not 'no cases'. Credit rating: no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings action found; rating = null, not public in the sources reached. Russia/CIS supply: no evidence found of any supply to Russia or CIS countries — no customs, B/L, distributor or export-destination record surfaced; the company's international pages reachable (international.haldiram.com) failed to load (connection closed) and the US site (haldirams-usa.com) covers only the US market. rf_supply = null: no evidence either way, not a denial. Per project rule 5, marketing claims on the company's own sites are not treated as evidence of actual shipments. Scope note: per role instructions I did not research legal identity, HS codes or shipment volumes; the Wikipedia revenue figure (₹12,800 crore FY24) is cited only as context and is not a verified rating or filing. Recommend re-running sanctions screening (OFAC/EU/UK/BIS) and eCourts/NCLT lookup once the search backend is restored before any decision.
